issue.title: MAVSDK Windows Installation
issue.body:
Hi, 
When installing MAVSDK on Windows, are we given the option to either 1) locally install mavsdk-windows-x64-release.zip or 2) clone the repository and cmake build and install? The zip folder does not contain a CMakeLists.txt so do we have to make one ourselves? Because of this uncertainty I tried the second approach by using:
git clone https://github.com/mavlink/MAVSDK.git
git submodule update --init --recursive
cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -Bbuild/default -S. 
cmake --build build/default -j8 
And was given this error message on the last command:
![Capture1](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/59535719/150206077-e8e5396a-bf28-4e2e-98b5-df698c934ab8.PNG)
Note the message is a lot longer but the errors all involve unresolved external symbols.

comments.body: I was just looking through previous Windows installation issues and came across this: https://github.com/mavlink/MAVSDK/issues/1357#issue-832349620. Used the same commands as the user and think I've managed to build and install without errors. Could you confirm that these are the correct commands for the debug version?
Your compiling commands look correct. I wonder why the linking fails for you but not in CI? Which MSVC version are you using? I'll try to reproduce this in my Windows later.
